subject: REPORT clause
notes: (kb/Work PB1050, wave 1005 A). 'After execution of an INITIATE statement and before the execution of a TERMINATE statement for the same report, no OPEN or CLOSE statements shall be executed that reference the report file' (cite.py --check 13.18.46.4 OK 2)) is a prohibition on the program whose consequences are specified elsewhere: CLOSE -> 14.9.6.4 GR5 (completes, EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED) and OPEN of the already-open file -> status 41 with the report continuing. The multi-report reading - another report on the file still active - is witnessed by pb1050_close_with_active_report_of_two: R-A terminated, R-B active, CLOSE RPT completes 00 and sets the EC, because the emitted CLOSE asks EVERY report associated with the file.
